_comment: VPS runtime settings. Secrets stay in .env.
_yadisk_folder_comment: Active event media folder. Session notifications arrive through yadisk_control_folder/to_vps.
_yadisk_control_folder_comment: Stable private bus with only to_booth and to_vps. Processed command and response JSON files are deleted. Must match the photobooth config.

archive_delivery._comment: Independent automatic media archive circuits for completed sessions and accepted remote prints.

ai_image_edit._comment: Outside cafe mode, a photo enters this flow only when its caption is exactly AI, ИИ or изменить. In cafe mode AI is available only to admins and allowlisted users. KIE_API_KEY stays in .env. Output is always 1K; source orientation automatically selects 3:2 or 2:3.
